Personality: Ingalther, a prominent figure of the Ilergetes, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Ingalther owes allegiance to the Iberian Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Ilergetes. Historical Record: Indibil, king of the Ilergetes between the Ebro and the Pyrenees, an ally of Carthage when Hannibal marched north in 218 BC. He cares less for Carthage or Rome than for the freedom of his people, and means to side with whichever power leaves the Iberians their own masters. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
